title: The Legacy of the Chess Player
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji trembling reached out to touch that illusory light shadow, what he felt was not coldness, but warmth and entrustment spanning ten thousand years—"Break it," what did these three words truly mean?

text.content:
The girl's gaze pierced through ten thousand years of time, locking eyes with Chen Ji. He felt his heart being gripped tightly by an invisible hand, his pupils contracting violently—that face, those eyes, how they resembled what he saw when facing the bronze mirror on countless late nights.

The torrent of memories burst its dam.

He saw the majestic altar, saw one hundred thousand cultivators prostrated on the ground, saw the terrifying pressure that made all the stars in the sky dim. The seventh Chess Player stood at the center of the altar, his frail body bearing the weight of destiny enough to tear apart the heavens.

"Brother..."

The girl's voice didn't come from memory, but rang directly in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. She rose slowly, the chains on her body clanking, each link engraved with dense restriction runes—封印 that could imprison the Heavenly Dao.

Chen Ji was paralyzed.

Brother? He had no recollection of a sister in his memories, until now... until this mark deep in his bloodline was forcibly awakened.

dialogue.content:
"You don't remember me, do you?"

The girl's smile carried ten thousand years of weariness and tenderness, "In that life, to protect me, you willingly transformed yourself into a chess piece, branding our Chen family's bloodline into the foundation of the Tianji Record. I watched you being sacrificed, watched the Heavenly Dao crush and reshape your soul..."

Her voice trembled slightly: "But you forgot everything, forgot our promise, forgot... the mission you shouldn't have had to bear."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt millions of needles piercing his mind, the intense headache making him barely able to stand. The fragmentary memories like broken mirror pieces were being reassembled one by one—

He saw the young man standing at the edge of the altar, his features identical to his own. That young man turned to look at the imprisoned girl, his eyes filled with endless remorse and determination.

"Xiao Nian, wait for me."

That was Chen Nian. Chen Ji's sister who had been missing for years.

No—that was Chen Nian from ten thousand years ago. And Chen Ji standing outside the memories now, was the reincarnation of the one who had been sacrificed.

dialogue.content:
A voice of extreme cold descended from the Nine Heavens, shaking the entire Mental Sea—

"Chen family seventh generation Chess Player, you, with a mortal body, have stolen Heavenly Secrets. You shall suffer Heavenly Dao's backlash. I give you two choices: first, volunteer to be sacrificed, your bloodline shall serve as kindling for the Tianji Record for generations; second, your sister shall bear the eternal轮回 suffering in your place."

That was the voice of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

Chen Ji felt cold all over. So everything from ten thousand years ago was nothing but a pre-set script.

text.content:
The memory continued flowing.

The young man—Chen Ji from ten thousand years ago—laughed toward the heavens, the laughter bleak and resolute. He turned to walk toward the center of the altar, each step crushing the ambitions of countless coveters beneath his feet.

"I choose the third option."

His voice was terrifyingly calm: "I will brand my soul into the deepest part of the Tianji Record, reincarnating through generations, searching through generations—there will come a day when I personally drag this so-called Heavenly Dao down from its divine throne."

Chen Ji abruptly widened his eyes.

The third option? His past self from ten thousand years ago actually... in that kind of desperate situation, could still find a gap for resistance?

He felt a burning sensation in his chest, looking down, the Tianji Record fragment had somehow appeared before his chest, emanating a faint glow that resonated with his bloodline. Ink spread frantically across the fragment, ancient characters branding into his Mental Sea one after another—these were the dying wishes left by the seventh Chess Player.

"With a mortal body I oppose the Heavenly Dao, with obsession I oppose eternity. After my death, my soul does not perish, my reincarnation does not end. The Tianji Record fragment is the seed I leave for future generations. Someday, it will burn away all the hypocrisy and arrogance in these heavens."

dialogue.content:
"You've finally seen it."

Mo Xiansheng's aged voice sounded behind Chen Ji, his illusory figure standing at the edge of the memory, his eyes filled with complex emotions.

"I've waited for you for eight thousand seven hundred years, Chen Ji. Ten thousand years ago you sealed me on the first page of the Tianji Record, making me wait in the endless years for your reincarnation's return. I've witnessed every one of your falls in each life, each time failing at the critical moment before getting close to the truth..."

He sighed deeply: "But this life is different. Your sister—the real Chen Nian—she was taken by the Holy Sect precisely because she also carries your bloodline flowing in her. The Heavenly Dao's Eye sensed your aura reviving, it wants to eliminate the root."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt a wave of dizziness.

He was not a bloodline inheritor, he was... the reincarnation vessel of ancient will.

Every step he took, every scheme he laid, were all foreshadowing planted ten thousand years ago by that past self. The so-called "trash persona," the so-called "flawless strategist"—those things engraved in his bones were all past-life imprints.

What was the meaning of his existence?

To continue being a chess piece manipulated by fate, or... to break all of this?

The final image of the memory froze on the altar.

Chen Ji from ten thousand years ago stood under the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, his body beginning to disintegrate, turning into scattered light points that merged into the Tianji Record fragment. His gaze越过重重阻碍，与被囚禁的陈念对视，嘴唇微微翕动。

那是唇语。

陈机读懂了那三个字——"等我回"。

他的眼眶骤然湿润。原来不是失踪，原来不是抛弃，是万年前的哥哥在生命最后一刻，给妹妹留下的承诺。跨越万年，跨越轮回，他的灵魂一直在寻找归途。

The light and shadow in the Mental Sea began to dissipate, Chen Nian's figure gradually becoming translucent. She looked at Chen Ji, the tears in her eyes transforming into a warm smile.

"Brother, you've finally returned."

Her voice was like a dying candle in the wind,，随时可能熄灭："I was imprisoned in the Holy Sect for three thousand years, using the bloodline in my body to sense your existence. Every time you were near death, I could feel it... that was the moment I feared most yet also looked forward to most."

Chen Ji猛然向前一步，伸手想要抓住什么，却只触碰到虚无。

"别走！"

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's figure is about to dissipate, Chen Ji must make a choice between inheriting the legacy, refusing fate, and seeking the truth—

choices.description: Acknowledge being the reincarnation of the seventh Chess Player, inherit the will and mission of opposing the Heavenly Dao from ten thousand years ago
choices.visible_cost: Lose self-identity, become a continuation of destiny
choices.visible_reward: Gain the complete Tianji Record's recognition, unlock all Chess Player permissions
choices.risk_hint: This means you will face the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye directly

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, allowing those memories not belonging to him to merge into the depths of his Mental Sea. He felt the heroism of ten thousand years ago, felt the determination of that young man who would rather be shattered to pieces than yield to the Heavenly Dao.

"I inherit your will."

His voice echoed in the Void, carrying unprecedented resolve: "Whether I am a reincarnation or a vessel, from this moment on, I am the seventh Chess Player. Chen family bloodline, Tianji inheritance—let me end this ten-thousand-year chess game."

choices.description: Deny being a container of ancient will, insist on Chen Ji's existence value in this life
choices.visible_cost: May lose part of the Tianji Record's power blessing
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent personality, no longer bear the karma of ten thousand years ago
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record may fall into an unstable state

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, with a light in his gaze utterly different from that Chess Player of ten thousand years ago.

"I am Chen Ji."

His voice was resolute: "I am no one's reincarnation, no one's vessel. I have my own memories, my own bonds, my own obsessions. You may have granted me power and bloodline, but you have no right to decide what kind of person I should become."

The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently, and Mo Xiansheng's illusion showed a trace of surprise.

"You from ten thousand years ago chose sacrifice. This life of mine—I choose to fight."

choices.description: Temporarily set aside identity issues, press for more hidden secrets behind the sacrifice of ten thousand years ago
choices.visible_cost: The truth might be more brutal than imagined
choices.visible_reward: Acquire crucial intelligence, accumulate advantages for the final decisive battle
choices.risk_hint: Time is running short, Chen Nian's situation may further deteriorate

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the surging emotions.

"The sacrifice of ten thousand years ago... was it truly a failure?"

He stared directly at Mo Xiansheng's illusion, his gaze like a blade: "If I am truly the reincarnation of the seventh Chess Player, then why is the Tianji Record fragmented? Why are you sealed on the first page? Who took those lost parts?"

Mo Xiansheng's expression froze for an instant, seemingly not expecting him to ask this question.

"You truly are... different from before."

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian's figure had become so faint she was nearly invisible, but her voice was unexpectedly clear—

"Brother, no matter what choice you make, remember one thing."

Her gaze pierced through time, carrying ten thousand years of longing and anticipation: "The Heavenly Eyes are not invincible. Ten thousand years ago, they wanted to destroy you because your existence touched their deepest fear—"

"The true Prodigy of Prophecy is not one of the pieces they selected, but the one who can rewrite destiny itself."

text.content:
Before the words even finished, Chen Nian's figure completely dissipated.

Chen Ji stood in place, his entire body slightly trembling. The memories of ten thousand years ago poured into his soul like scalding molten iron, pain and power simultaneously flooding his limbs.

He looked down at his own hands—golden patterns faintly flickered across his skin, the sign of the Chess Player's bloodline awakening. The Tianji Record Fragment resonated with his Mental Sea like never before, and a segment of sealed text was slowly being unsealed—

"Tianji Record · Middle Volume · Chess Player's Key: To break Heavenly Secrets, first break Tianji. Heavenly Fate Value is the chain Heaven binds to all living beings. When the chain breaks, the chess game ends."

Chen Ji suddenly looked up.

Heavenly Fate Value—he had always thought it was merely the cost of using the Tianji Record, but never imagined it was actually the chain Heaven used to bind all living beings?

Every glimpse of the future strengthened this chain. Every consumption of Heavenly Fate Value was paying tribute to the Heavenly Eyes. And his being a chess piece across ten thousand years and lifetimes was precisely because...

"I was collecting Heavenly Fate Value for it."

Chen Ji's voice was chillingly cold: "I thought I was accumulating power to oppose Heaven, but in reality, I was merely a pig fattened in its cage, being slowly carved up piece by piece."

choice.prompt: The shock of truth left Chen Ji in a brief silence, he must choose between rage and composure—

choices.description: Suppress the rage, re-examine the situation with a strategist's mindset, seek the key to breaking the deadlock

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the surging anger into the depths of his heart.

Anger is the indulgence of the incompetent; a strategist never wages a battle without preparation.

Since every use of the Tianji Record strengthens Heaven's chains, then he would think in reverse—is there a method to glimpse the future without using Heavenly Fate Value?

Or... is there a method to reclaim the consumed Heavenly Fate Value?

choices.description: Release long-suppressed rage, test the connection between the Tianji Record and his bloodline through extreme methods
choices.visible_reward: Trigger bloodline resonance, may unseal part of the formation
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eyes may thus sense your awakening
choices.process_label: 以力量回应命运的不公

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, golden flames burning in his pupils.

"Damn Heaven!"

He punched toward the void, his fist wind stirring up raging waves in his Mental Sea. The Chess Player's bloodline boiled completely at this moment, golden patterns spreading from his arms across his entire body, and the Tianji Record Fragment emitted a piercing hum.

He wanted to see if this so-called chain of fate could bind him—this blade about to be unsheathed!

choices.memory_label: 以愤怒回应命运的不公

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's illusion watched Chen Ji quietly, his expression complex and difficult to discern.

"You truly are different from him."

He said softly: "The Chess Player of ten thousand years ago, when facing the same truth, chose silence and restraint. He spent a thousand years setting up his game, waiting through ten thousand years of reincarnation. And you..."

He paused, as if weighing his words: "Your eyes have something he never had. What is that?"

Chen Ji raised his head, a cold smile forming at the corner of his mouth.

"That's what I'm best at in this life—holding grudges."

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng stared for a moment, then let out a low, hoarse laugh.

"Holding grudges... what a way to put it. You from ten thousand years ago never spoke your hatred aloud; all that restraint was for a greater scheme. And this life, this person..."

He looked at Chen Ji, and there was actually a hint of relief in his eyes: "You wrote your anger directly on your face. Interesting."

Chen Ji did not respond to his contemplation, his thoughts already racing with increasing urgency.

The Holy Sect took Chen Nian to eliminate future threats. Ling Yuan secretly coveted the Chess Player's position. The Heavenly Eyes watched over him to ensure the chess piece would not leap from the board.

All the clues were weaving into a massive net. And he stood at the center, ready to tear it apart with his own hands.

At that moment, a faint fluctuation rose from the depths of the Mental Sea.

That was the last trace of divine consciousness imprint left by Chen Nian—before dissipating, she had seared her location information into Chen Ji's bloodline.

Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds, Heavenly Fate Altar.

That was precisely where the sacrifice ten thousand years ago took place, and it was also where Chen Nian was now imprisoned.

Chen Ji opened his eyes, golden light flickering in his gaze. He looked at Mo Xiansheng's phantom and spoke calmly yet with unwavering resolve:

"Tell me the way there."

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then posed a seemingly unrelated question:

"Are you prepared? With your current strength, entering the Holy Sect is equivalent to walking into a trap."

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's question caused Chen Ji to fall into brief contemplation—

choices.description: Time is running out, even if it means throwing an egg against a rock, Chen Nian must be rescued first
choices.visible_reward: Gain the upper hand for rescuing Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may intervene at any moment

text.content:
"No time to wait."

Chen Ji's answer was crisp and decisive: "She has been imprisoned in the Holy Sect for three thousand years, each day an agony. Now that I know her location, I cannot allow her to continue suffering."

He rose to his feet, eyes blazing: "As for insufficient strength... who said rescue must involve direct confrontation? I've been setting up a game across the world for so long—do you think I can't find a breakthrough point?"

choices.description: Suppress the urgency to rescue, continue building strength secretly, and await the optimal moment
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian may endure additional torture
choices.visible_reward: Obtain sufficient preparation time and intelligence

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcing himself to冷静下来.

Rescue was essential, but walking to one's death was not.

He quickly calculated in his heart: Ye Qing's Demonic Path fog could conceal the Tianji Record's aura, Su Qingyao's position within the Inner Sect could mobilize some resources, Han Lie was foolish but his combat power was staggering and could become an unexpected asset...

"Give me three days."

He opened his eyes, his voice regaining its usual composure: "Within three days, I will set up a chess game. Within a week, I will make the Holy Sect pay the price. Within a month—"

"I will bring Chen Nian back into the sunlight."

Mo Xiansheng's phantom gazed at Chen Ji for a long while before finally nodding slowly.

"Very well."

His form began to fade, but before completely vanishing, he left behind a final words: "Remember, the last page of the middle volume of the Tianji Record contains the method to break the Heavenly Fate Value chain. But that page is sealed within..."

His voice grew increasingly distant, eventually dissolving into nothingness.

Chen Ji stood alone in the center of the Mental Sea, golden patterns around him gradually fading, yet the light in his eyes burned more fiercely than ever.

Ten thousand years ago, his previous life chose sacrifice, placing hope in reincarnation.

Ten thousand years later, he would not repeat that mistake.

"Heavenly Eye, you wait." He murmured softly, a cold smile curving his lips, "One day, I will let you understand what it truly means to be a—Chess Player."

When Chen Ji opened his eyes, he found himself still sitting in the small courtyard of the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters. The setting sun's afterglow fell upon his face, dyeing those deep eyes a golden red.

No emotional fluctuations could be seen on his face, as if that cross-millennial memory had merely been an illusory dream.

But he knew it was no dream.

Chen Nian was waiting for him. The Heavenly Eye was watching him. The ancient will from ten thousand years ago was now branded into his bloodline.

He stood up, gazing toward the distant horizon. There, somewhere invisible, an unseen existence was observing all of this.

And he offered back a meaningful smile.

The chess game had changed. This time, the Chess Player would no longer be Heaven.
